title: Solar Lighting Kit with 3 LED Bulbs and USB Phone Charging
description: Get practical portable lighting with three LED bulbs, a rechargeable 6000mAh battery, a solar panel, and USB charging for compatible mobile devices.

kitInAction.title: Complete lighting kit
kitInAction.description: The complete LM-3605 set includes the main unit, solar panel, three LED bulbs, and connecting cables for flexible portable lighting.

kitInAction.title: Product Specifications
kitInAction.description: The LM-3605 combines a 6V 4W solar panel, 3.2V rechargeable battery, three 3W LED bulbs, and USB charging output in one practical lighting kit.

kitInAction.title: USB and bulb output ports
kitInAction.description: The rear panel provides the controls, one 5V 1A USB output, and dedicated 3V connections for the included LED bulbs.

kitInAction.title: USB mobile phone charging
kitInAction.description: Connect a compatible mobile device to the built-in 5V 1A USB output for convenient everyday charging.

kitInAction.title: Built-in LED flashlight
kitInAction.description: A built-in LED flashlight adds a focused light source for navigating dark areas and everyday tasks.

kitInAction.title: Practical off-grid lighting
kitInAction.description: Designed for dependable lighting at home, outdoors, or during power interruptions, with solar charging and portable phone power in one compact kit.
